description: This file defines a custom layout manager class 'CustomLayout' extending ViewGroup, including measurement and layout logic, custom layout parameters, and handling of child views with specific positioning and gravity.

classes.name: CustomLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges child views with specific left, right, and middle positioning, supporting gravity and margins.

classes.name: CustomLayout.LayoutParams
classes.description: Custom layout parameters extending MarginLayoutParams, including gravity and position attributes for child views.

methods.name: shouldDelayChildPressedState
methods.description: Indicates whether to delay the pressed state for children; returns false.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures all child views and determines the size of the layout based on children and gutters.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions all child views within the layout according to their layout parameters.

methods.name: generateLayoutParams (overload)
methods.description: Creates layout parameters from existing ViewGroup.LayoutParams.

methods.name: checkLayoutParams
methods.description: Checks if the provided layout parameters are instances of CustomLayout.LayoutParams.
